nodes.name: Chain Orchestrator.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-010) documenting the end-to-end Layer-3 composition root that threads a banked snapshot through consume to execute to persist as one deterministic call. Records its dependencies on every chain stage, its files under src/orchestration, and its governing ADRs.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed markdown node with YAML frontmatter (canonical_id, depends_on, related_files) and a required Relationships section for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Decision Engine.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-002) documenting the Supervisor Office treasury-upgrade Decision Engine that scores candidate upgrades under budget constraints and emits a deterministic decision packet. Explicitly scoped separate from the gold trading decision branch.

nodes.name: Execution.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-008) documenting the first money-shaped Layer-3 module that turns an ADMIT decision plus portfolio state into a paper fill and new portfolio state, wiring GATE-001. Records the deterministic simulated-broker core and the default-off Alpaca adapter.

nodes.name: Feature Builder.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-004) documenting the deterministic, snapshot-local transform under src/features that turns a validated Layer-2 snapshot into a provenance-tagged feature vector with no historical state.

nodes.name: Gold Decision Builder.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-006) documenting the deterministic builder under src/gold that turns a feature vector plus regime classification into a frozen, paper-only gold decision packet with confidence and uncertainty scoring.

nodes.name: Gold Forward-Return Labeler.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-009) documenting the strictly-downstream, read-only calibration module under benchmarks/calibration that labels banked gold decisions with realized forward gold returns, the ADR-012 gate G3 measurement prerequisite.

nodes.name: Guardrail Engine.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-001) documenting the risk-control Guardrail Engine under src/risk that evaluates a conjunction of hard-limit trade-validation predicates and returns an approve/block decision at the trading-to-broker boundary.

nodes.name: Market Regime Classifier.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-005) documenting the deterministic rule-selection engine under src/regime that classifies a feature vector into exactly one of twelve market regimes via priority-ordered first-match selection.

nodes.name: Operations Control Plane.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-011) documenting the ops/ package, a local terminal operator console (governed read-model plus Textual TUI) over the Layer-3 runtime, exposing three action tiers behind confirm, audit, and precondition gates.

nodes.name: Paper-Trading Runtime.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-007) documenting the first stateful Layer-3 component under src/gold/paper_runtime that admits a pure gold decision packet against explicit ledger state and computes the stateful L3 admission guards (duplicate, operational, cooldown).

nodes.name: Snapshot Consumer.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-003) documenting the Layer-3 ingestion boundary under src/snapshot that reads the Layer-2 truth snapshot via the Snapshot API and fail-closed gates whether Layer 3 may act on it.
